title: Evidence viewer
responsibility: Shows full-size screenshots with filtered navigation, viewport switching and before/after comparison.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.items
inputs.description: Required full screenshot evidence list, used to find comparison partners and available screen sizes. Partners match comparison identity and viewport with before/after phases.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.navigableItems
inputs.description: Required ordered subset for previous/next and arrow-key navigation. Without an item different from selected, both arrows are disabled, movement is ignored and the navigation hint is hidden.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.selected
inputs.description: Required selected screenshot or null. Non-null opens the modal; null shows the unselected message.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.assetBase
inputs.description: Required prefix concatenated with image files for zoom and download links.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.onclose
inputs.description: Required close callback; closing also resets view to after.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback receiving a navigated item. Viewport switches pass true as the second argument so the host can update filters; ordinary previous/next omit it.

outputs.name: EvidenceViewer
outputs.description: An unselected message or a screenshot lightbox initially showing after, with before/compare choices when a partner exists. Previous/next wraps through available neighbours and resets to after. Without neighbours, arrows are disabled and the navigation hint is hidden. Viewport switching prefers comparison, then category/title, category, then first candidate. Title and top provenance describe the displayed side; comparison uses after metadata and each image retains its own caption and note. Changing image/view recreates zoom state.

errors.name: onclose callback error
errors.description: An error thrown by onclose propagates when the viewer closes.

errors.name: onselect callback error
errors.description: An error thrown by onselect propagates when navigation or viewport switching selects evidence.

errors.name: each_key_duplicate
errors.description: Svelte rejects a comparison whose before and after evidence share the same id.
